standards.title: Stud Spacing
standards.rule: Wall studs must be spaced 16 inches on center (OC) for load-bearing walls. 24 inches OC allowed for non-load-bearing.

standards.title: Door Frame Rough Opening
standards.rule: Rough opening must be 2 inches wider and 2.5 inches taller than door slab for standard pre-hung doors
standards.violation_indicator: Door does not fit, excessive shimming

standards.title: Stair Rise and Run
standards.rule: Maximum riser height 7-3/4 inches, minimum tread depth 10 inches. Variation between steps < 3/8 inch.

standards.title: Nailing Schedule
standards.rule: Use 16d common nails for framing (3-1/2 inch). 3 nails per stud connection for 2x4.
standards.violation_indicator: Insufficient or wrong-size nails, structural weakness

standards.title: Moisture Barrier
standards.rule: Install sill sealer (foam gasket) between concrete foundation and bottom plate to prevent moisture wicking
standards.violation_indicator: Rot at base of walls, musty smell

safety.requirement: N95 mask or respirator when cutting wood, especially treated lumber and MDF
Earplugs or earmuffs when operating saws > 85 dB (all power saws)
Use riving knife, anti-kickback pawls, and push sticks on table saw
Steel-toe boots required when handling heavy lumber or working at elevation

tools.name: Circular Saw
tools.use: Straight cuts in lumber and sheet goods

tools.name: Nail Gun
tools.use: Fast framing assembly with rapid nail driving

tools.name: Measuring Tape
tools.use: Accurate measurement - minimum 25 ft for framing
